events.title: PAYDAY: Aces High - Demo is out NOW!🔥
events.summary: Welcome Heisters!The vault has opened and the flood of playtesters are joining in to start plotting their revenge on Warren Jupiter. Take part in the familiar Flowtrust Bank along with a brand new location of a Cosmopolitan Museum of Art. How will you go about it - the stealthy Clubs way or guns blazing Spades way? Your choice. Other than that, we are very proud to announce the official release date of the full version of PAYDAY: Aces High! It will come out on both Steam and Meta on November 5th

events.title: Steam Demo coming Oct 19!

Playing the demo also unlocks an exclusive Kitty Mask for you in the full game as it launches later this year. 💥Wishlist the game today and get notified when the demo is live!Please also be aware that while the game is close to going gold, we're is still working hard to get everything 100% ready for launch.
